Welcome to my new website at [gdkrmr.com](https://gdkrmr.com).

The old site ran on Hugo with the Academic theme. I have rebuilt the site from scratch with [Quarto](https://quarto.org).

- Hugo academic is not supported any more.
- Simpler workflow, especially publication management.
- I use Quarto for many other projects.
